howto.what: 当用户请求为新成员生成项目上手指南时，Claude会读取项目的知识图谱，自动生成一份包含项目概述、架构层、关键概念、文件地图等内容的Markdown文档，并建议保存到项目中。
howto.when: 当用户需要为新加入项目的团队成员生成一份引导指南时触发。

howto.what_en: When asked to create an onboarding guide for new team members, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph and generates a Markdown document with project overview, architecture layers, key concepts, file map, and more, then offers to save it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs an onboarding guide for new members joining a project.
